_comment: Defaults for the solver window's field colours, one pair per theme: negative and positive field. The user can change any of them in Settings (View group) and reset to these. Hex RRGGBB.
source: user requirement, 2026-11-19: light theme traditional blue (negative) and red (positive); dark theme a colour-blind-safe pair from the Okabe-Ito palette, which is specified in CMYK values (sky blue #56B4E9 and yellow #F0E442), chosen on the blue-yellow axis that stays distinguishable in red-green colour blindness and with yellow clearly lighter than blue so sign also shows in lightness. Wong, B., Points of view: Color blindness, Nature Methods 8:441 (2011), doi:10.1038/nmeth.1618
